tasks.label: Sync origin and remove stale local branches
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; git fetch --prune origin; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $current = (git branch --show-current).Trim(); $remoteBranches = @(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:strip=3)' refs/remotes/origin | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'HEAD' }); $localBranches = @(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads); foreach ($branch in $localBranches) { if ($branch -eq $current) { Write-Host "Skipping checked-out branch: $branch"; continue }; if ($remoteBranches -notcontains $branch) { Write-Host "Deleting local branch: $branch"; git branch -D -- $branch; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } }
